literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single construct from PMC5217011: the full-length MMP15 ORF cloned into lentiviral vector GV287 whose element order is Ubi-MCS-3FLAG-SV40-EGFP. The 3×FLAG cassette sits 3′ of the MCS, making it a C-terminal fusion to whatever ORF is inserted. MMP15 is a type-I transmembrane protein (N-out, C-in): its N-terminus is extracellular (mature start residue 42, after signal-peptide cleavage at 41) and its C-terminus is intracellular (residues 648–669). A C-terminal FLAG therefore lands on the intracellular face and cannot serve as an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line names a residue position, and the topology-derived position (C-terminus, residue 669) is intracellular. The N-terminal extracellular terminus (after residue 41) is the only surface-accessible terminus, but no ledger line reports a tag placed there. Because the sole derivable position is intracellular, zero extracellular surface sites qualify. The C-terminal FLAG is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: The GV287 vector architecture (Ubi-MCS-3FLAG-SV40-EGFP) places 3×FLAG C-terminal to the ORF insert; for MMP15 (type-I TM, N-out C-in) the C-terminus (residues 648–669) is intracellular, so the FLAG tag faces the cytoplasm and is not accessible on the cell surface.
